title: Starter Cottage Visibility + Cutaway Shell Repair
changes: Interior wall/opening pieces no longer render while the player is outside the BuildingInstance.
Starter cottage rear/divider visuals use exact 1-tile cutaway-cap components instead of 3-tile drywall strips.
Front and bedroom doors default closed so exterior/interior door art reads as a full door before interaction.
W54F twin-gable roof geometry is retained for one controlled visual retest after removing leaked interior wall art.
